newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers 1-yr bonds to public at 96.5 zlotys.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers 1-yr bonds to public at 96.5 zlotys.

text.p: The Polish treasury said on Thursday it will sell its one-year floating bond, due on March 4, 1998, to the public at an issue price of 96.5 zlotys and a subscription price of 95.5.

It said the one-year bond, with a coupon of three percentage points above year-on-year inflation two months before the first day of the public sale, will be available to subscribers from January 20 to February 2, 1997.
The bonds will be available to the public from March 3 to May 30, 1997.
The treasury cut the price of its bonds, previously at 102.5 and 103 zlotys, because from this year investment in treasury bonds is no longer tax-deductable.
